title: 加载界面不会自动结束，需要玩家点击才能继续，且游戏未提示
description: 加载界面不会自动结束，需要玩家点击才能继续，且游戏未提示
evidence: The first thing that will "please" you is a loading screen that never ends. You wait... wait... and then realize it's not a loading screen -- you must click. Yes, the game didn't bother to tell you.
